title_sq: Tek Bulevardi i Ri, Shitet Super Apartament 3+1+2, Me Post Parkimi Te Perfshire Ne Cmim!!!

title_en: On New Boulevard, Super Apartment 3+1+2 for sale, with parking space included in the price!!!
description_en: At Bulevard i Ri, super apartment 3+1+2 for sale, with a regular floor plan and parking space included in the price!!! The property is located on the 9th residential floor, and has a gross area of ​​156.3 m2, from which the net area is 135.4 m2. The property is organized by a distribution corridor, living room with kitchenette, 3 bedrooms, 1 double bedroom wardrobe, 2 bathrooms and 2 balconies. The orientation of the property is South-East-West. The area in which the apartment is located offers all the necessary facilities for a comfortable life.
